{"command": "cd /tmp && python3 -c "
import urllib.parse, zlib, gzip, io, bz2, lzma
data=[l for l in open('posts.txt').read().split('\n') if l.strip()]
odd=[]
for i,line in enumerate(data):
    d=urllib.parse.parse_qs(line,keep_blank_values=True)
    n=d['n'][0]
    if len(n)%2: odd.append((i,n)); continue
    b=bytes.fromhex(n)
    for f in (zlib.decompress, lambda x: zlib.decompress(x,-15), lambda x: gzip.decompress(x)):
        try: print(i,f(b)[:100]); break
        except: pass
print('odd count',len(odd))
print([len(n) for i,n in odd])
open('odd.txt','w').write('\n'.join(i+':'+n for i,n in odd))
""}
